card.name: Spots just before a 'lesson' or 'school' word
card.fires_on: Partway through a word or name where the next piece would be 'lesson', 'schule' or similar, such as 'Violinschule' or 'Min-ile-sson'. It also fires on 'a' or 'and' right before 'lesson(s)'.

modes.label: Inside split-up words
modes.description: Fires on a middle piece of a rare or foreign word that ends in a lesson- or school-like part.

modes.label: Just before 'lesson'
modes.description: Fires on a small word that leads directly into 'lesson' or 'lessons'.

modes.description: Fires on a piece of an unusual proper name or botanical word with no clear link to lessons.
